_meta.description: Nepali overlay for src/lib/countryStatus.json. Only translated fields live here; everything missing falls back to the English source file. Never fork the full dataset.
_meta.tiers: Translated tier definitions, keyed '1' | '2' | '3' | '4' | 'unknown'. Fill from locales/ne.json tiers.descriptions when reviewed.
